sections.title: Logging
sections.description: Records plugin actions to daily log files in the uploads directory. Useful when diagnosing a problem; leave it off otherwise.

fields.title: Enable logging
fields.help_text: Write plugin actions to a daily log file. Errors are always recorded in PHP's error log regardless of this setting.

fields.title: Slack webhook URL
fields.help_text: Optional: an incoming webhook URL (https://hooks.slack.com/services/...) that log entries are also posted to. Leave empty to send nothing to Slack. Anyone holding this URL can post to the channel, so treat it as a credential.

fields.title: Send to Slack
fields.help_text: Errors are posted even when file logging is off. Every log entry means one HTTP request per entry, and Slack rate-limits a webhook to about one message per second — only worth it on a quiet site or while chasing a specific problem.
